power.jaymospowers.web.desc: A spider's body: harder punches, quicker feet, higher jumps, steadier footing and softer landings, growing as you master the power. Swing on one web or two. Both webs out + Sneak: slingshot (hold Jump to draw). Hold Jump in mid-air: web wings (Sneak while gliding to airbrake). Sprint and leap alongside a wall to run along it; Jump kicks off it, higher as you master the power.
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_1: Hold: main-hand web swing (release on the upswing for a boost)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_2: Hold: off-hand web swing (empty off hand)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_3: Needs web shooters with web in them (one web a shot; on organic web V does nothing). Tap, as fast as you can: a web pellet; five hits in a row web the target up. Sneak + tap: web bomb (cocoons everything near it). Hold, then let go: web blast; past half charge it pins what it hits to the wall (pinned things take 50% more damage). While Yank holds something: a shock down the line
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_4: Tap: Yank. Hold: web lead; let go aimed at a block to hitch it there. Aimed at a block: hold on one, let go on another for a walkable webline
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_4.ear: Hold on one block, let go on another: a walkable webline (Yank builds on it later)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ultimate: Web Strike: zip to what you aim at and kick it
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ultimate.name: Web Strike
message.jaymospowers.web_fists_on: Your fists are sticky with web.
message.jaymospowers.web_fists_off: The web on your fists dries up.
message.jaymospowers.web_fists_suit: No web gets through the suit.
message.jaymospowers.web_shot.no_shooter: Web Shot needs web shooters: your own web won't shoot.
message.jaymospowers.web_shot.dry: Your web shooters are dry. Load a Web Cartridge.
key.jaymospowers.web_symbiote: Power Skill (Webbed Fists, Symbiote menu, Tempest Kick)
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.edge: It's had almost enough of you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.infect: There. A web slinger. That one was made for us... not you.
We smell silk on the wind. We are leaving you.
A better host. Close. Let go of us.
Hungry. You were only ever a meal away from empty.
Starved in you. We go to find better.
message.jaymospowers.web_ascend.0: The air hums against the back of your neck.
message.jaymospowers.web_ascend.1: The hum sharpens into a tingle.
power.jaymospowers.web.key.starter: Before your first ability, only these: web wings (hold Jump while falling) and Webbed Fists (%7$s). From the first on, everything you learn is kept and builds on the last
power.jaymospowers.web.key.starter.name: Wings & Fists
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.cushio: It pools over your legs. Brace. We land together.
Too far. Too fast. It thickens round your feet.
The ground is coming. It won't let it have you.
It took the fall. You're broken, but breathing.
It spreads under you like a pool of tar, and you live.
Bones jar. It holds them together. Not yet.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.instin: Tendrils burst from your back before you can think. It wants to live.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sulk: You let it starve. It tears itself off you, seething.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sulkin: It won't come. It's still angry with you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sulk_o: It creeps back to you, calmer now.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.inedib: It recoils. It won't touch that.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.spree: It's in a foul mood. It isn't hungry for food any more. Fight it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.rip: Walls won't stop it. It tears through.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.stress: It shifts under your skin, restless.
It's irritable. It doesn't like this.
It seethes. Something will have to give.
It hates you right now. It wants out, or it wants blood.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.annoye: Again? It heard you the first time.
It hisses. The same thing, again.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.fed_up: Enough. It takes your legs and walks you away from this.
It's done telling you. You're leaving.
It snarls, seizes you, and storms off.
Far enough. It lets you go, still sulking.
It drops you here. Don't make it do that again.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.stuck_: It can't get through. It lets go of you in disgust.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.hesita: It stops. It knows that smell. Throw it away, or it won't wait.
It hesitates over the body. Someone you knew? Decide. Now.
It holds still, mouth open over them. A moment. Only a moment.
It goes still. Their face is right there. Three heartbeats, then it eats.
It sniffs at them and pulls back. Not this one? Then get rid of it.
Something in it flinches. It remembers them through you. It won't remember for long.
It waits, tendrils curled over the body. Your call. Quickly.
It stops chewing the air. Was this one a friend? It's asking. Answer with your arms.
A pause, almost polite. Then the hunger comes back.
You throw the body clear. It lets it lie.
You fling them away. It sulks, but it lets them go.
The body hits the ground away from you. It turns its head, and doesn't follow.
You toss it aside. It hisses once and lets it lie.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.flint: It SCREAMS. Not fire. Never fire.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.just_l: It sets them down. It was only looking.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.not_lo: It didn't like what it saw.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.defend: You're dying. It isn't. It takes over to save itself.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.flee: It vanishes into itself and RUNS. It will not die here.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.bulk_d: The big suit sinks back into the tendrils.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.hint: Point at one and let go of the key to use it.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.unlock: It gives you this at bond %s
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.mask_on: Mask on: take the suit's head off and show your face
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.mask_off: Mask off: your face shows (pick again to cover it)
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.mask_no_su: Only while the suit is on (not the big suit)
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tendrils_o: Tendrils out: pick to draw them back in
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tendrils_i: Tendrils in: pick to bring them out (over whatever you wear)
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tendrils_l: Locked until it trusts you more (they come with Living Armor)
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.suit_wait: Comes once it has given you %s of %s abilities
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.neglec: You forget us. Fine. We do it our way now.
Ignored. Again. Then we take what we want.
You never listen to us. Now we don't listen to you.
Left to rot inside you. No more. Watch us.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sated: Full. Quiet now. For a while.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.well_f: Full, and warm. Keep us like this and we listen.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.locked: It won't give you that. Not yet.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.resist: You fight it for your own limbs.
You pull against it. It doesn't even notice.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.break_: You wrench yourself back. It lets go, sullen.
Not so fast. We are not done with you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.lockou: Fine. Walk around naked and soft. See how long you last without us.
You tore us off. Like a child with a scab. Don't come crawling back.
Ungrateful meat. We carried you. Now carry yourself.
So weak, and still you fight us. We will remember this.
The black seeps back over your skin. It hasn't forgiven you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.locked: No. You wanted to be alone. Be alone.
Ask nicer. Or don't. Still no.
You threw us off. We're still sore.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.gift.1: Here. Drive it yourself, then. Try not to trip.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.gift.2: We'll let you hold the reins. Don't get used to it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.gift.3: Your turn at the wheel. We'll be watching you fumble.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.gift_o: Playtime's over. We take it back.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.unlock: It trusts you with its tendrils now.
It will wear you, if you ask. Living Armor.
It teaches your hands to cling. Wall Crawl.
It will share a meal with you now. Consume.
It will bristle on command. Spike Burst.
Fully bonded. The big suit is yours to move.
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_1.sym: Hold: swing on black rope. Living Armor: a tendril grabs a creature or item, let go to throw; Sneak at a block: it struggles, then tears out a chunk (click: charged swing; holding a corpse, click: thrash it)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_2.sym: Hold: off-hand swing. Living Armor: the other tendril grabs and throws; Sneak at a block: it struggles, then tears out a chunk
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_3.sym: Hold, then let go: a blast of black mass
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_4.sym: Tap: Yank. Hold: lead; let go aimed at a block to hitch it there. Further reach
power.jaymospowers.web.key.mode: Web Zip to where you aim (hold Sneak to land on it)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.mode.name: Web Zip
power.jaymospowers.web.key.mode.symbiote: Web Zip, further and quicker to recover (hold Sneak to land on it)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.special: Webbed Fists: for 30 seconds your hits stick, slowing harder each time; the third cocoons them (30 s cooldown, from when you coat them)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.special.name: Webbed Fists
power.jaymospowers.web.key.special.symbi: Hold: the symbiote menu (mask, tendrils, Tendril Grab, Living Armor, Wall Crawl, Consume, Spike Burst, Shroud; each unlocks as the bond grows, and the mask once 4 abilities have). Sneak + %7$s: Webbed Fists
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.suit_l: Not yet. It won't wear itself for you until it trusts you. (Unlock 4 of its abilities.)
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.mask_o: It peels back off your face. Let them see you, then.
It flows back up over your face. Better.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.mask_n: There's no mask to take off: the suit isn't on.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tendri: They sink back into us. Quieter, this way.
They reach out of us again. Better.
They stay under your skin. Not until we trust you more.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.suit_w: It slides back under your skin. It will come again when it trusts you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.harden: It hardens over you like armour plate. Nothing gets through. Not yet.
NO NO NO. NOT LIKE THIS. MOVE.
WE ARE DYING. IT TAKES THE LEGS.
It screams inside your skull. RUN. RUN. RUN.
YOU WILL NOT DIE. WE WILL NOT DIE.
It tears the controls from you. Live first. Argue later.
Too much blood. Too much. It bolts.
Get away get away get away GET AWAY.
It won't lose another host. It takes you and flees.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.protec: Bleeding. Enough. It takes your body and turns on them.
Mine. Nothing touches what's mine. It surges over you to fight.
Down, little host. We do this part.
Five breaths was all. It seizes you again: they're still on you.
You wrench it off. It lets you, for a breath or five. Not more.
Gone. Breathe. It loosens its grip, still bristling.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.alarm_: FIRE! It shrieks and peels away from the heat!
It's BURNING! It thrashes and recoils from the flames!
The heat! It writhes and screams in your blood!
It shrinks from the fire, howling. GET AWAY FROM IT.
That sound! It shrieks and convulses under your skin!
The noise tears through it! It recoils, screaming!
It writhes at the sound. MAKE IT STOP.
It shudders off you at the noise, wailing!
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.st: The sky screams. We like it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.ra: Wet. Cold on the skin we share.
Water from the sky. Strange world.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.de: Deep. Stone all around. It feels like home.
So far down. Nothing hears us here.
Dark and close. We like the deep.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.hi: The air is thin up here.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.ho: Hot. Too hot. It burns the skin.
The heat. We hate the heat.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.wa: We sink. We swim. Get out.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.vi: They stare at us. Let them.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.mo: Things that want us dead. Let them try.
Rot and bone nearby. We smell it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.be: Animals. They know what we are.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.pl: Another of your kind. Watch them.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.co: A body. Still fresh. We could eat.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.la: Fire in the ground. Stay away.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tour.v: Look. All of it, below us.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tour.w: Water over there. We want to see it.
Deep water. What lives in it?
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tour.v: Them. We want to look at them.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.climat: Too long in the sun. Too long.
Get us out of here. Or we will.
Out of the heat. We walk.
You wouldn't leave. So we will.
Too long in the ice. Too long.
Get us somewhere warm. Or we will.
We are freezing solid. Leave. Now.
Out of the cold. We walk.
You wouldn't leave. So we will.
item.jaymospowers.web_shooter.hint: Use: strap them on. Sneak + use: load cartridges from your inventory. Worn: Sneak + use with an empty hand, aiming at nothing, takes them off.
item.jaymospowers.web_cartridge.hint: Use while wearing web shooters to load the emptier one.
message.jaymospowers.web_shooter.none: Strap on web shooters to load a cartridge.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.dormant: Dormant: it's still settling into you (about %s min)
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.dorman: ...warm. So warm in here. Let us... sleep a while.
Your bones. We are learning the shape of your bones.
Shh. We are finding where everything goes.
Your heart is loud. We will learn its rhythm. Then it will be ours too.
Not yet. We are still... unpacking.
Every vein. Every nerve. Such a strange, soft home.
You won't feel us much longer. That's how you'll know we've settled.
Hold still... there. That fits better.
We dreamed of the cold between stars. You are better.
Rest. We'll wake when the house is ready.
...not yet. We are still settling in.
Hush. Nothing answers until we fit.
Too soon. We haven't found our way round you yet.
We're awake. We're home. Now... let's see what we can do.
You'll have to tear us off.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.fight_: Fine. Breathe, then. We're still everywhere else.
Your face. Keep it, for now.
Look at you. So small without us.
Too weak. You'll never get us off like that.
We are not a coat you shrug off.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.face_b: Back where you belong. Behind us.
We missed seeing through your eyes.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.say.wh: Hold on to us. We won't let you fall.
One reach at a time. Breathe.
The stone gives. It doesn't have to hurt.
Away. Nobody has to bleed today.
Run with us. We'll mend later.
Thank you. It was already gone.
Nothing wasted. Rest now, little one.
It's warm again. We can help more now.
Easy. We only want to hold you still.
Something's wrong. We felt it first.
It's over. It can't hurt anyone now.
We're sorry. It had to stop.
Done. Let's find who it hurt.
Let the light pass over us.
Up and over. We'll catch you.
Fly a little. We've got the rope.
Sorry, sorry. It was in the way.
Back! Not to hurt. Just back.
So many little hearts out there.
That will bruise. It will heal.
Come loose. We won't break you.
There. Hold still. We'll close it.
We can fix this. Let us.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.say.re: Up! The view's better for spotting meat.
Tear the ground open! What's hiding?
Down, down, down. Something's warm under there.
Fine. We'll come back for them.
Got you! Don't wriggle, it's worse.
Blood nearby. We can smell it.
RUN! It's more fun when you run!
They'll never see the teeth coming.
Into the dark. Then into their throats.
Up we go, for a better kill.
Smash it all to red bits!
That's ours now. So are you.
Hold still so we can hit everything!
We'll tear you apart from inside!
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.wh: The sky is angry. Stay close to us.
Thunder. We'll keep you dry.
Loud up there. We don't mind, with you.
Rain. Everything gets a drink.
It's washing the world clean.
Soft. We like the rain.
Dark now. Keep watch for the hurt ones.
The stars are out. Gentle light.
Night. Things get hurt at night. Stay ready.
So far down. Is anyone lost here?
Quiet stone. Old and still.
The dark doesn't scare us. Not with you.
So much sky. Everything looks small and fine from here.
Careful up here. Falls hurt.
We can see the whole world breathing.
Too hot. Drink something.
The air is heavy. Rest in the shade.
Burning sun. We'll cool you.
Cold. Let us keep you warm.
Your fingers are cold. Closer.
Frost. Everything's sleeping.
Water. Cool. Clean.
Swim slowly. We're holding your breath.
It's calm under here.
People. Are any of them hurt?
So many little homes. Keep them safe.
Listen. Children. Be gentle here.
Those ones hurt people. Stop them.
Something cruel is out there. Be careful.
Keep them away from the others.
Look. They're so soft.
Leave them be. They're happy.
Little lives. Let them graze.
Someone else. Are they all right?
A friend? Wave. Be kind.
Another heart like yours.
It's gone. Nothing left to save.
We were too late for this one.
Gone already. It won't mind now.
Fire under the earth. Stay back.
That would hurt. Badly. Away.
Careful. Not even we could mend that.
Peaceful. Let's stay a moment.
Nothing hurts here.
Quiet is good. Breathe with us.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.re: Lightning! Let's go stand in it!
The sky is screaming. Scream back!
Storms make them hide. We'll find them.
The rain is the wrong colour.
Everything comes out in the dark. Everything bleeds.
Things live down here. Let's find them.
Deep and dark and full of meat.
Up here we can see everything worth killing.
Drop on them from here! Splat!
Look at them all. Tiny. Soft.
Hot. Like the inside of something.
We like the heat. It's like fresh blood.
Sweat. Smell. We can track you anywhere.
Things go slow in the cold. Easy kills.
Get out of the water so we can hunt.
A whole pen of them. For us?
They hunt too. We hunt better.
A big one. With a heartbeat.
Let's see what colour they are inside.
Throw something in! Watch it pop!
Too quiet. Something should be screaming.
Someone's hurt. Let us go. Please.
We hear it bleeding. We're taking the wheel. Just for a moment.
Over there. Hold still, we'll walk you.
THAT. The other one. We'll tear it out of whatever it wears.
Another of us. Not one of us. Kill it.
Smell that? Something wearing our skin. Not for long.
The red one. It hurts everything it touches. Stop it.
The other one, the black one. It'll kill again if we let it.
That one's sick with hunger. We have to stop it. Forgive us.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.red.ri: Ha! One of the soft ones! Rip it out of its little host!
Another one of us? There's only room for RED.
Ooh, a rival. We'll wear its host as a hat.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.red.hu: We smell blood. Ours now. Hold still.
Too slow! We're driving. There's meat over there!
Hungry, hungry, hungry. Your legs are ours.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.red.pu: Your nice little wind. Your nice little flowers. We'll eat them too.
No! You don't get to make us soft!
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.purity: ...what was that? Something in us went... still.
That feels... strange. Don't do that again. ...Do it again.
We don't like how quiet that made us. We don't hate it, either.
Oh. Oh, it's so quiet. We... we don't want to hurt anything anymore.
So tired... we gave too much. Feed us, and we'll wake.
Mm. We're back. Thank you. Who needs us?
...we gave all we had. Something to eat, please.
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.asleep: Asleep: it gave too much mending. Feed it (Consume) to wake it
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.rescue: One blow took everything. Lie still. We are covering you.
Whole, then nothing. Not while we are here. Let us in.
That should have ended you. We spread over you now. Breathe.
Too close. Far too close. We are closing over you.
You were slipping. We hold you together. Lie still a moment.
Almost gone. We cover the wounds. Wait for us.
Bled down to a thread. We knit it. Don't move.
So little left of you. We fill the rest.
A thread, and fraying. We bind it. Hold on.
One blow? Then we answer with ours. GET BACK.
They nearly took you whole. Now they learn what we are.
Gone in a heartbeat, they thought. WRONG.
Close enough to smell it. Away from us. AWAY.
They pressed too near. We push back. Up.
You were almost theirs. Never. We throw them off.
A thread left, and they still reach for it? NO.
Cut to a thread. We cut back.
Barely breathing, and they crowd you. We clear them.
Get up. Everything we have is yours. Fight.
We are in your blood now. Use us. Win this.
Our strength is yours a while. Don't waste it.
One blow, and you were gone. We said no. Up.
That should have killed you. It nearly did. We don't allow it.
From whole to nothing in a heartbeat. Get up. We are leaving.
One blow from %s and you were gone. We said no. Up.
%s nearly ended us in a single stroke. Not today.
From whole to nothing, by %s. Get up. We are leaving.
Too close. Far too close. Up.
Your heart stopped for a moment. We started it again.
Almost a corpse. Not yet. Not while we're in you.
%s almost had you. Almost. Up.
Your heart stopped for a moment. %s will pay for that later. Now we go.
Almost a corpse, for %s. Not while we're in you.
You were hanging by a thread, and you let them cut it. We tied it back.
Bled down to nothing, a little at a time. Foolish. Up.
One more scratch and there would be no you to save. Up.
Hanging by a thread, and you let %s cut it. We tied it back.
%s whittled you down to nothing. Foolish. Up.
One more scratch from %s and there would be no you to save.
There. Yours again. Try not to die this time.
Safe enough. Take the wheel, and be smarter with it.
Breathe. We won't carry you out twice for free.
Too hungry... too far from you... we can't lift you.
Starved, and you never fed us. Lie there.
Nothing left in us to save you with.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.un: %s. Rotten meat that walks. Tear it apart.
%s stinks of the grave. We don't eat that.
%s. Slow and stupid. Take its head.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.sk: %s. All bones, no meat. Close the distance.
%s and its little arrows. Get inside its reach.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.cr: %s. It hisses. Do not let it hug us.
Kill %s from further away. We like our skin.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.sp: %s. Eight legs and no manners. We have more.
%s thinks it is the one with webs. Show it.
%s. Pull its legs off one at a time.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.en: %s. Don't look at its eyes. Look at its throat.
%s blinks about like a coward. Catch it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.ne: %s. Fire. We hate fire. Kill it fast.
%s burns. Keep it off our skin.
%s. A thing of the furnace. Put it out.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.pi: %s. Greedy pig. It wants your gold. It gets our teeth.
%s. Tusks and temper. Ours are worse.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.go: %s. Iron. It won't feed us. Why are we fighting it?
%s hits hard. Harder than you. Move.
%s. A guard dog made of metal. Go round it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.il: %s. Grey-faced and cruel. Good. We can be crueler.
%s. Raiders. Their blood is as red as anyone's.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.vi: %s? It's soft. It's barely a fight.
%s. Are we sure about this? Fine. Make it quick.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.pl: %s. Another one like you. Show them what you carry.
%s thinks it can take us. Let it learn.
%s. Watch its hands. Then take them.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.be: %s. Claws and fur. Ours are better.
%s. An animal. It bites. So do we.
%s. Put it down and maybe we eat.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.se: %s. Things from the deep. Drag it up.
%s, in the water. We swim better than it thinks.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.bo: %s. Now that is something worth fearing. Good.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.bi: %s is big. Big things fall loud.
%s. Go for the legs. Then the rest.
%s. Too big to fight fair. So don't.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.foe.ot: %s. What is it? Doesn't matter. Kill it.
%s. We don't know this one. We'll learn by tearing.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.say.wh: It's frightened. So were we, once.
Quickly, then. Don't draw it out.
We're sorry it came to this.
Finish it, then let us go.
We don't enjoy this. Don't you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.say.ex: Hold it still. We'll do the rest.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.say.wh: Don't make us wind it tighter.
